entityDescription:
LambSpace aims to revolutionize the small satellite industry, firstly by producing high-performance polymer structures for small satellites from PEEK using injection molding. This approach shortens production time compared to aluminum structures, lowers costs, minimizes resource use and offers advantages such as lower mass, better corrosion resistance and a lower carbon footprint. 
On the other hand, LambSpace aims to develop and manufacture new innovative small actuators based on shape memory alloys. This technology is particularly well suited for space applications due to its light weight and robustness. Shape memory actuators can be used for various locking and unlocking tasks, such as solar panel and antenna modules.

The Consortium is non-profit and pursues among its aims the dissemination of technical-scientific culture through multiple training and dissemination activities (exhibitions, seminars, conferences, educational-training laboratories, workshops, etc…) in order to stimulate the interest of citizens and in particular of young people in the problems of research and scientific experimentation, also through the use of new multimedia technologies. The field of intervention of the initiatives is aimed at the field of mathematical, physical and natural sciences and derived technologies.Theresearch topics addressed are multiple, and in some respects even different, although a common underlying theme emerges.These can be grouped into the following macro areas:

- Experimental Physics

- Physics of the atmosphere and climate

- Teaching and History of Physics

Hydromars AB is science-based deep-tech company that develops a circular water system for deep space missions.
Based on proprietary technology from its parent company, Hydromars uses a new unit operation that aims to make it possible to perform the main task of recycling in the spaceship and achieve complete recovery and 100% clean water.

Hydromars collaborates with leading Institutes (German Aerospace Centre (DLR), Swedish Environmental Research Institute (IVL), KTH Royal Institute of Technology (KTH), Interuniversity Microelectronics Centre (imec)) and multinationals (Airbus Defence & Space) and has received initial funding from ESA BIC Sweden and Seal of Excellence from the EU.

Spin-offs from Hydromars will contribute to a new circular economy on Earth for optimal recycling of resources. This will contribute to environmental improvements such as mitigation of global warming and resource depletion.

MyScienceWork (MSW) is an innovative technology company that provides a suite of data solutions for research institutions, universities, publishers, libraries, and more. 

- Sirius is a suite of innovative data science solutions that helps scientists and their institutions to automate tasks to map, manage, analyse, and promote their results to all stakeholders of research.

- Polaris OS is an innovative open-source solution for data management. In all its different forms, it is used to store, manage and showcase contextual metadata for research activities such as people, organisations, projects, research outputs, grants, contracts, and so on, as well as all the links between them.

Our vision for the near future is to empower research institutions and industries with more intelligence related to research fields by aggregating all available data related to research results to accelerate findings, optimize funding and research efforts, improve transparency, bridge the knowledge gap between academia and industry and avoid duplicate research.

The company believes that making science more accessible will foster data sharing amongst science organizations.

entityDescription:
Remote Sensing Business Solutions (RSBS) is the parent company of Four Point and the owner of the intellectual property for TerraEye. RSBS is a forward-thinking company specializing in leveraging advanced satellite data and artificial intelligence for innovative solutions in the mineral exploration and mining industries. Their flagship product, TerraEye, epitomizes their commitment to revolutionizing these sectors with cutting-edge technology.
Company Overview:
- Name: Remote Sensing Business Solutions (RSBS)
- IP Ownership: Holds the intellectual property rights for TerraEye, a state-of-the-art platform designed for mineral exploration and mining.
- Specialization: Focused on integrating diverse data streams from satellites, drones, and ground sensors to provide comprehensive insights into exploration sites.
- Technological Edge: Utilizes advanced machine learning algorithms and extensive datasets to translate complex environmental patterns into actionable intelligence for more precise and efficient mineral exploration.
Key Features of TerraEye:
- Unified Data Streams: Integration of data from various satellite constellations, UAVs, ground sensors, and existing company datasets.
- Advanced Data Processing: Proprietary machine learning algorithms are employed to ensure high levels of accuracy and relevance in data interpretation.
- Comprehensive Monitoring: Offers a blend of real-time data streams, historical pattern analysis, and predictive analytics in a user-friendly application.
- Sustainability & Responsibility: Aims to mitigate the environmental impact of mining and exploration, aligning with global sustainability trends.
Market Position:
- Unique Selling Proposition: Unlike traditional geological services or generic data analysis platforms, TerraEye by RSBS offers a comprehensive, integrated approach combining satellite data insights with UAV and ground sensor data.
- Competitive Landscape: TerraEye stands out in a market that includes traditional geological services, satellite-only data providers, generic data analysis platforms, environmental monitoring tools, and dedicated mining software. Its integration of real-time geospatial data and advanced analytics sets it apart.
Company Strategy:
- Innovation Focused: Continually seeks to innovate and enhance its offerings in the mineral exploration sector.
- IP Strategy: Proactive in protecting and leveraging its intellectual property, TerraEye, as a competitive asset and business lever.
- Sustainable Practices: Emphasizes sustainable mining practices, balancing economic benefits with environmental responsibility.
Future Outlook:
RSBS aims to maintain its leadership in the field of remote sensing and AI for mineral exploration by continuously evolving TerraEye and exploring new technological frontiers. Their approach not only offers significant benefits to the mining industry but also contributes to environmentally responsible practices, making them a pivotal player in the intersection of technology, exploration, and sustainability.

entityDescription:
Grupo Sureste, founded in 1993 in Murcia, initially focused on Private Security, leveraging the extensive experience of its professionals. With over 2,000 highly qualified staff, including 57 Higher University Graduates, the company operates 24/7 in the Autonomous Community of the Region of Murcia.
The company prioritizes clients, emphasizing peace of mind for individuals, institutions, and companies relying on their outsourcing services. Grupo Sureste rejects improvisation, opting for systematic auditing, diagnosis, and efficient provision of necessary systems and resources.
Investment in personnel training has been a cornerstone of their growth. Holding licenses for surveillance and security installations, Grupo Sureste complies with various authorizations from the Directorate General of Security.
Quality policy is paramount, with certifications such as ISO 9001:2000, ISO 14001, and OHSAS 18001. The company's commitment to responsible communication is acknowledged by the Responsible Communication Seal.
The company's infrastructure boasts a 2,500 m2 intelligent building serving as its central headquarters, including an Alarm Receiving Center—the largest in the Mediterranean Arch. With authorized delegations in several Autonomous Communities, Grupo Sureste has a national presence, complemented by commercial offices in each capital.
Operational capacity is enhanced by the Operational Control Center (OCC) located in Murcia. The OCC, compliant with the law on Private Security, facilitates surveillance, protection, and response functions, ensuring constant contact with security forces and emergency services.
Technologically advanced, the OCC allows immediate information retrieval, extensive knowledge of security systems, and reliable responses. Communication systems include RTC, mobile telephony, and IP, with redundancy for network security.
The OCC's hardware and software integrate video verification, call recording, and web access for clients. Integration of systems allows the reception of signals from various security systems, enabling faster verification.
Alarm processing involves qualified personnel, ensuring proper verification. Key custody services include on-site visits and response to alarms, carried out by security guards in compliance with regulations.
Grupo Sureste's commitment extends to quality certifications, environmental responsibility, and corporate social responsibility. The company's continuous improvement policy, supported by an in-house occupational health and safety prevention department, reflects its dedication to excellence.
In summary, Grupo Sureste's operational excellence, technological prowess, and commitment to quality and security make it a reliable partner for diverse sectors, contributing to its national prominence in the private security domain.

entityDescription: Neutron Star Systems (NSS) is a space start-up revolutionising near-Earth operations, in-space logistics and deep space missions. We are a market enabler for high power missions focused on delivering disruptive and innovative electric propulsion systems incorporating the latest high temperature superconductor technology (HTS). Our product offering offers superior flexibility and versatility, customisable to a wide range of spacecraft mission scenarios. This translates into mission optimisation and millions in cost savings for our customers. Closing the gap between R&D and commercialization for Applied Field Magnetoplasmadynamic (AF-MPD) technology, we build disruptive and robust electric propulsion (EP) systems and subsystems based on the latest superconductor technology. Our unique selling proposition addresses the needs of five main markets: 1. On-Orbit Servicing, Assembly, and Manufacture 2. GEO satellites for multi-domain and multi-level secure communications 3. Solar weather monitoring and detection constellations 4. Lunar and cis-lunar transportation 5. Mars and asteroid cargo missions A Unique Idea NSS is developing the SUPREME thruster – an EP technology that offers a unique combination of features based on superior operational flexibility, scalability, cost-effectiveness, and thrust efficiency compared to the competition. SUPREME offers a wide operational range and operation on alternative, cheap propellants. Our throttleable technology can be optimised to almost any mission scenario, allowing maximum utilisation of propellant. Our operational flexibility opens new possibilities for hybrid chemical/electric propulsion systems while reducing the dependence on rare and expensive propellants such as Xenon. Our efficient technology and use of propellants such as Argon and Ammonia leads to significant savings in mission costs, with savings growing exponentially towards higher powers. Unlike many other potential high-power EP systems, AF-MPD thrusters have a 60-year research and flight heritage and their technology is well understood, simple, reliable and robust. MPD thrusters have been previously limited by the large mass of the electrical components however, with the introduction of HTS, these obstacles can be overcome. The larger magnetic fields which can be generated with HTS enable an increase in thruster performance and an extension of the thruster lifetime. NSS is in close partnership with the institute of space systems (IRS) at the University of Stuttgart. IRS brings a long-lasting heritage of electric propulsion R&D development, in particular MPD thrusters, along with world-class facilities for the testing of high power EP systems. In the past years, they have designed and tested the SX3 thruster, an AF-MPD thruster which has reached ground-breaking thrust efficiencies of 62%. Concept Our design concept exploits the significant research heritage of AF-MPD thrusters and combines this with key enabling HTS technology to produce lightweight, compact and energy efficient thrusters. Unlike traditional electromagnets, the use of HTS coils, with their high current densities, will allow magnetic fields up to 1T to be generated. This in turn allows thruster operation at lower discharge currents and higher voltage, resulting in lifetime increases and improved operational performance.

We believe that the future of space exploration relies on collaboration between the public and private sectors, and that's why we focus on training commercial astronauts who will play a crucial role in this adventure.
With the commercialization of space, its exploration is becoming increasingly accessible. In the context of a growing number of professionals, the Spaceflight Institute was created to address an essential need: to train professional commercial astronauts. Our training is based on three pillars: knowledge, interpersonal skills, and technical skills.
What sets us apart is our commitment to providing training in accordance with FAA Part 14 CFR 460 standards, ensuring the safety and competence of our learners. Our collaboration with renowned partners in human spaceflight enhances the quality of our training and allows us to innovate by offering new services for emerging players in the space sector.

With our tracker HCPV panels can remain completely stationary, just like conventional panels, with the benefit of a much higher efficiency (~30% vs. ~20%) and easy installation.
This allows for a higher energy output on the same installment area, especially useful in space limited applications, like balcony power plants or rooftop installations.
